title: Reviewed effect instructions and serializable resolution frames, not card text

queries.description: Host answers to the executing attack's board/zone/history query nodes, keyed by the node's sorted-key JSON (battleQueryKey). Counts are nonnegative integers, predicates booleans. Absent when the attack has no query node; a holder that does not exist has no answer.

effectCards.description: Cards actually moved by each counted earlier effect of this attack execution (II.B-02, II.D-02).

damageTargetSelection.description: Attack damage targets: a damageSelection, or repeat = 「选择N次对手的宝可梦，给被选择的所有宝可梦，造成被选择次数×X伤害（同1只宝可梦可以选择多次）」: N single picks (the same Pokémon may be picked again); each picked Pokémon takes the numeric amount × its picks as one damage packet.

to.description: deckTop/deckBottom: 「放回牌库上方／下方」 in the chosen order (the first chosen ends uppermost); from the deck, the rest is shuffled first (「将剩余的牌库重洗，将选择的卡牌放回牌库上方」). prizes: 「…反面朝上作为对手的奖赏卡放置」, from the opponent's discard pile only.

oneOf.description: 「选择自己的1张手牌，将剩余的手牌全部放于弃牌区」: the user keeps count hand cards of their choice and moves all the others.

lookBottom.description: 「查看自己牌库下方N张卡牌」: the window is the bottom N cards of the deck (lookTop null).

excludePaid.description: Printed 「无法选择因为这张卡牌的效果而被放于弃牌区的…」: cards discarded to pay this activation's own cost are not eligible.

onePerAlternative.description: Printed 「「A」和「B」各1张」 (II.D-04 文例4): at most one card for each selector alternative.

alternativeLimits.description: One limit per selector alternative, in order. 「最多2张宝可梦，和最多2张基本能量（可只选择宝可梦或只选择基本能量）」: at most limits[i] chosen cards are counted against alternative i, and quantity.count is their sum. With exclusiveAlternatives, 「最多2张【基础】宝可梦或1张进化宝可梦」「最多2张【基础】宝可梦，或最多2张基本能量」: every chosen card comes from one alternative, within its own limit, and quantity.count is the largest limit.

exclusiveAlternatives.description: With alternativeLimits: all chosen cards belong to one alternative (「…或…」 between two searched groups).

distinct.description: 「属性各不相同的…」: no two chosen cards share a printed type (a Pokémon's types, a Basic Energy's type); 「名字各不同的…」: no two share a name.

remainder.description: 「将剩余的卡牌放于弃牌区／加入手牌／（以任意顺序重新排列）放回牌库上方／下方」: the looked-at cards not chosen, without a shuffle; several going back to the deck are put in the order the user chooses, the first chosen uppermost.

side.description: 「对手弃牌区中的…」「查看对手牌库上方N张卡牌…」: the opponent's cards, to the opponent's zones; the effect user chooses.

prizeZone.description: Prize cards as a zone (prizes.zone, prizes.face-up); a face-down Prize is chosen by position only. lookPrizes: 「查看所有反面朝上的自己的奖赏卡，再放回原处」 (own, all) / 「选择1张反面朝上的对手的奖赏卡，查看…后，放回原处」 (opponent, 1). flipPrizes: 「将自己的奖赏卡全部正面朝上」 (all) / 「选择反面朝上的自己的1张奖赏卡，将其翻到正面」 (1); face up until they leave the Prizes. swapPrizeDeck: 「选择1张反面朝上的（对手的）奖赏卡，将其与（对手）牌库最上方的卡牌，在反面朝上的状态下互换」. resetPrizes: 「将奖赏卡全部放回牌库并重洗牌库」 (deck) / 「将奖赏卡全部反面朝上重洗，放回牌库下方」 (deckBottom)，「然后，从牌库上方抽取与被放回的张数相同数量（same）／N张卡牌，作为奖赏卡放置」; both = 「双方玩家，各…」. prizeHandSwap: 「选择最多N张自己的奖赏卡，加入手牌。然后，选择与加入手牌张数相同张数的手牌，反面朝上作为奖赏卡放置」. deckTopToPrizes: 「将对手牌库上方N张卡牌，作为对手的奖赏卡放置」.

arrangeDeck.description: 「查看（自己／对手／自己或者对手）牌库上方（下方）N张卡牌，以任意顺序重新排列，放回牌库上方（下方）」 (to top/bottom), or 「…，再放回原处」 (to same: looked at, order unchanged, II.C-20). either: the user picks whose deck. otherwise: 「或者，放回牌库后重洗牌库」 (shuffle) / 「或者，将那些卡牌全部翻到反面重洗，放回牌库下方」 (shuffleBottom), chosen after looking.

opponentHand.description: The opponent's hand (II.C-20; II.D-04 文例2; II.E-33). look: the effect user looks at the whole hand (「查看对手的手牌」), then may choose printed cards there; faceDown: the user picks without seeing faces (「在不看正面的前提下选择对手N张手牌」), uniformly at random; opponentChooses: the opponent chooses from their own hand (「对手选择对手自己的N张手牌」). leave: 「直到手牌变为N张为止」. Without selector/quantity/to it only looks.

to.description: prizes: 「查看对手的手牌，将其中1张卡牌，反面朝上作为对手的奖赏卡放置」; lost: 「…放于放逐区」.

coin.description: A coin protection: it applies only if the coin flipped when this damage reaches 6.最终伤害 is heads.

atMost.description: Prevents only damage of at most this much at 6.最终伤害.

oneOf.description: 「在这种情况下，…」 after an optional play cost (effects.optional-cost): effect only when it was paid, else otherwise (if any).
II.E-38 「这场对战（算作）自己的胜利／己方败北」 (win.effect): the game ends here with that result for the effect user.
「将双方战斗宝可梦身上放置的伤害指示物，全部互换」 (damage.counters-swap): each Active Pokémon gets the other's count; an opponent's Active protected from this effect keeps its counters and the user's Active loses its own.
effects.discard-self 「然后，将这张卡牌放于弃牌区」: the source Tool or Special Energy, while it is still attached.
II.E-20 「使用了这张卡牌的回合结束时，…」 (effects.turn-end): program is recorded for this turn and opened when it ends, before the checkup.

optional.description: 「若希望，可将该宝可梦…」: the bound next part is optional.

chooser.description: 「对手若希望，可…」: the effect user's opponent decides; absent = the effect user.

oneOf.description: Before damage, cards turned face up or shown, recorded for the attack's own formula; nothing moves (cn.countedReveal@1).
The cards an earlier revealCards of the same attack recorded go on (cn.revealedCards@1).
Before damage, 0 to maximum damage counters on the attacking Pokémon, the number recorded for the attack's own formula.
The next part of a thenMoved with use pokemon, bound to the Pokémon its first part affected.
「当这个回合结束时，自己的回合会再开始1次」 (turn.extra); ifKnockedOut = only if this attack Knocks Out an opponent's Pokémon.
「若希望，可追加造成N伤害。在这种情况下，…」: the user's before-damage choice, recorded for the attack's own formula and later entries.

options.description: 「从2个效果中选择1个使用」: each printed option, with the reviewed handler binding the host asks whether it could change anything now.

oneOf.description: CN II.C-05 文例1 p28; II.C-17 p38; II.D-04 文例1 p43: flip once; only the printed outcome runs the nested instruction. The flip itself is never an RNG receipt players can choose.

player.description: 「双方玩家各抛掷1次硬币」: the other player flips this coin; absent = the effect user.

otherwise.description: 「如果为正面则A，如果为反面则B」: the other face runs this instead.

oneOf.description: II.E-38 文例3: an attack's later instruction decided by the coins its own damage already flipped (condition over coin facts), never a new flip.
「如果〈条件〉（的话），则A」／「…，如果不是，则B」: a non-damage instruction decided by the board at the moment it is reached in the printed order; the condition reads only facts that exist then (the load guard).

「抛掷N次硬币／抛掷硬币直到出现反面」, then by how many flips show one face (II.B-02 文例2 counts heads; II.A): scale = the nested instruction is written for one such flip and its count (path count, or quantity.count) is multiplied by that number, none performing nothing; all = only when every flip shows that face; atLeast = when at least that many do.
Printed 「A。或者，B」: B runs only when A was not actually performed (the user declined or could not perform A). Never both.
CN II.E-36 p74: put each targeted whole hand into its owner's deck, then shuffle that whole deck. An empty hand with a nonempty deck still shuffles; a combined single card counts as shuffled.
CN I.H; II.A p18-19: 「抽取卡牌，直到自己的手牌变为N张为止」, counted from the hand when this draw begins (after any earlier part of the same text).
CN II.C-07 p30; II.D-16 p50: 「放置伤害指示物，直到其剩余HP变为「N」」, (remaining HP − N) ÷ 10 counters read when they are placed; none when the remaining HP is already N or less.

all.description: 「给对手所有的备战宝可梦身上放置伤害指示物，直到其剩余HP均变为「N」为止」: every Pokémon of the target, each to its own N.

side.description: event: whichever player's Pokémon fired the trigger (target event only).

targets.description: 「给N只宝可梦各放置」: N distinct Pokémon each receive count (II.A: all of them when fewer).

cureAll.description: 「回复…HP，并恢复其全部特殊状态」: the same Pokémon also recovers from every Special Condition it has; it may then be chosen when it has one, even undamaged.

oneOf.description: 「将与受到的伤害数值相同的伤害指示物，放置于使用了招式的宝可梦身上」: as many counters as the damage ÷ 10 of the attack-damage event that fired this reaction.
「回复这只宝可梦与给对手战斗宝可梦造成的伤害相同数值的HP」: as much HP as this attack's damage to the opponent's Active Pokémon.

target.description: event: the Pokémon a delayed reaction is on (E-20 文例2 「在下一个对手的回合结束时，受到这个招式影响的宝可梦会【昏厥】」).

oneOf.description: 「恢复…特殊状态」 (I.F): the listed Special Conditions the target has are recovered; count = the user chooses that many of them.

quantity.description: upTo 「最多N个」: the player chooses 1 to N of the origin's counters (II.D-05); all: every counter on the origin(s); any: one counter at a time until the player stops.

oneOf.description: prizes.take-effect 「拿取N张自己的奖赏卡」: the user takes that many of their own Prize cards (as many as there are).
ko.prize-modifier: this attack's 「多拿取N张奖赏卡」, kept as the user's turn-long prizeBonus for this attack.
The Pokémon a thenMoved's first part affected: the enclosed leaf acts only on them.

evolutionPermission.description: 「这只宝可梦，即使是最初的自己的回合以及刚被放出的回合也可进行进化」 (firstTurn, sameTurn) and 「这只宝可梦，可以从手牌使出从「X」进化而来的（「宝可梦ex」）卡牌，放于其身上进行进化」 (fromName, cardSelector): what the affected Pokémon itself may evolve into, and when (evolution.permission).

healBefore.description: 「在进化前，将这只宝可梦的HP，全部回复」: when it evolves from the hand by the fromName permission, it is fully healed first.

among.description: 「其中的…」: only the cards the first part of a thenMoved actually moved. A program writes "moved"; the host binds the actual card instances when that first part completes.

energyTypes.description: 「【超】或【钢】能量」: a Basic Energy card of any of these types.

owner.description: Reference player for own/opponent in this effect. For a shared Stadium activation this is its user, not necessarily the physical card holder or a triggered choice's controller.

duration.description: thisTurn: 「在这个回合（结束前）」, the user's current turn up to its end (before the checkup).

oneOf.description: 「在离开战斗场之前」: no turn limit; like other attack effects it ends when that Pokémon moves to the Bench, leaves play, evolves or devolves (II.C-15; clearOnBench and clearOnEvolution must be true).
「在这场对战结束前」: a player effect that lasts for the rest of the game, for every Pokémon of its scope including ones put into play later.

lastingSpec.description: The ledger's targetId, not the source Pokémon or a moving aura, determines the affected Pokémon.

priorEventIds.description: Already recorded, not-yet-dispatched attack events at establishment. A new reaction cannot retroactively observe them.

playerPokemon.description: 「（也包括新出场的宝可梦）」: while the player effect lasts, every Pokémon of that scope (relative to the effect's user), including ones put into play later: restriction (「自己所有的宝可梦，无法使用招式」「对手无法从手牌使出宝可梦进行进化」), damage received (「自己所有的宝可梦，受到对手宝可梦的招式的伤害「-30」」), protection (「自己的所有宝可梦，都不会受到招式的伤害和效果影响」) or an erased attack cost (「【草】或【火】宝可梦使用招式所需能量，全部消除」).

playerModifier.description: 「在这个回合，自己的（X）宝可梦所使用的招式，给对手战斗宝可梦造成的伤害「+N」」: the affected player's own attacking Pokémon of the printed kind, while the player effect lasts.

perPrizesTaken.description: 「会因为每张对手已经获得／自己已获取的奖赏卡而「+N」」: amount × the Prize cards that side (relative to the effect's user) has already taken (II.D-17), read when the damage is calculated.

actions.description: attachSpecialEnergy = 「无法从手牌使出并附着特殊能量」: the player's attachment of a Special Energy card from hand (I.A-04). playFromHand = 「无法从手牌使出卡牌」: no card of the player's hand comes into play or is used — Basic Pokémon to the Bench, evolution, Energy attachment, Trainers, an Ability of a card in the hand, and effects that attach a hand card or put it onto the Bench or onto a Pokémon; discarding from hand, Retreat and cards in play are unaffected (effects.player-lock).

suppression.description: Remove specified in-play Ability text or attached Tool effects, not the physical card, printed definition or already-resolved effects. specialEnergy = 「…身上附有的特殊能量的效果全部消除，被视作1个【无】能量」: every effect of the attached Special Energy cards of the scope is removed and each provides 1 Colorless Energy.

excludeTags.description: 「（除宝可梦【ex】外）」「（除「未来」宝可梦外）」: Pokémon with any of these printed tags keep their text.

damaged.description: 「身上放置有伤害指示物的宝可梦」: only a Pokémon that has damage counters on it now.

exceptAbilityNames.description: 「特性（除「X」外）」: Abilities printed with exactly this name, on any card, keep their text.

sourceTool.description: 「如果这只宝可梦身上放有「X」的话」: only while the source Pokémon has an attached Tool card matching this Trainer selector (the physical card, I.B-02).

outOfPlay.description: 「…场上、手牌中、弃牌区中的…特性，全部消除」: also the Abilities of matching Pokémon cards in the hand and the discard pile (abilities channel; the printed card's stage, tags and types).

attackDamageOptions.description: 「这只宝可梦所使用的招式的伤害，不计算对手战斗宝可梦身上所附加的效果」: each attack of an affected Pokémon deals its damage as if cn.damageOptions@1 ignoreDefenderEffects were printed on it (damage step 5, I p7).

ignoreWeakness.description: 「这只宝可梦所使用招式的伤害，不计算弱点（、抗性）」

playerAttackDamageOptions.description: 「在这个回合，自己的「X」所使用的招式的伤害，不计算…」: the player's own Pokémon of the printed kind.

prizeBonus.description: 「如果因为这个招式的伤害，对手的宝可梦【昏厥】的话，则多拿取N张奖赏卡」「在这个回合，如果因为自己「X」宝可梦所使用的招式的伤害，而导致对手战斗宝可梦【昏厥】了的话，则多拿取N张奖赏卡」: the player takes N more Prize cards for an opponent's Pokémon Knocked Out by damage from that player's attack (ko.prize-modifier).

attack.description: Only damage from this attack (cn.extraPrizes@1): its declared attack, user and copy execution.

activeOnly.description: Only the opponent's Active Pokémon (「对手战斗宝可梦」).

targetSelector.description: The Knocked Out Pokémon's kind (「对手的【基础】宝可梦」「宝可梦GX・EX」).

attackerSelector.description: The attacking Pokémon's kind (「自己「太晶」宝可梦所使用的招式」).

playerPrizeBonus.description: A turn-long bonus of a played card: not tied to one attack.

prizeModifier.description: 「当该宝可梦，受到对手宝可梦的招式的伤害而【昏厥】时，对手拿取的奖赏卡将减少1张」「即使这只宝可梦【昏厥】，对手也无法拿取奖赏卡」「受到这个招式影响的宝可梦【昏厥】时，多拿取2张奖赏卡」: read for an affected Pokémon when it is Knocked Out (ko.prize-modifier: increases and decreases add up, D-11/D-12; none = no Prize card at all).

byOpponentAttack.description: Only when Knocked Out by damage from an attack of its opponent's Pokémon (「受到对手宝可梦的招式的伤害而【昏厥】时」).

attackerSelector.description: 「受到对手「宝可梦V」的招式的伤害」: the attacking Pokémon's kind.

coin.description: 「…【昏厥】时，自己抛掷1次硬币。如果为正面，则对手拿取的奖赏卡将减少1张」「…如果为正面，则多拿取1张奖赏卡」: at the Knock Out the effect's player flips 1 coin; only heads applies it (ko.prize-modifier-coin).

group.description: 「这个效果，无论拥有这个特性的宝可梦有多少只，都不会叠加」: of the same group only one applies (one coin).

attack.description: Only if this attack Knocked Out an opponent's Pokémon this turn.

deckChoice.description: Private original-deck receipt. Cards remain in deck until the full selection/allocation is resolved; this is not a public projection or an approval/authentication token.

picks.description: The Pokémon picked so far for a repeat damage selection (repeats allowed).

transferred.description: Counters a 「任意数量／最多N个」 transfer has moved so far.

benchLimit.description: The number of Benched Pokémon a player may have becomes limit (ordinary limit I.A-04). scope all: both players (「双方玩家可以放于备战区的宝可梦数量，变为N只」); opponent: the provider's opponent (「对手可放于备战区的宝可梦数量…变为N只」). requires: only a player who has an in-play Pokémon matching it (printed Stadium text). sourceActive: 「只要这只宝可梦在战斗场上」. When several apply to a player, the smallest wins (printed 「关于变更备战宝可梦的数量的效果，优先执行数量更少的效果」).

turnKept.description: 「只要这只宝可梦在战斗场上，即使自己使用了「X」，自己的回合也不会结束」: an own Item/Supporter matching trainer, played while this holds, does not end the turn by its 「如果使用了这张卡牌的话，则自己的回合结束」 (judged when the card is played).

discardToHand.description: effects.discard-to-hand 「当这张卡牌，要被从场上放于弃牌区时，不会被放于弃牌区，而是被放回手牌」: this attached Tool or Special Energy goes to its owner's hand instead whenever it would be put from play into the discard pile (a Knock Out, a Retreat cost, an effect), while its effect is in force; not when it goes to the Lost Zone or the deck.

knockoutZone.description: ko.lost-zone (I.D 【昏厥】的处理步骤 3): a Knocked Out Pokémon of the scope goes to the Lost Zone instead of the discard pile; it is still Knocked Out (Prizes as usual). cards pokemon = 「不将该宝可梦放于弃牌区，而是放于放逐区。（除宝可梦以外的卡牌，全部放于弃牌区。）」 (its Pokémon cards; attached cards to the discard pile); all = 「该宝可梦以及放于其身上的所有卡牌…放于放逐区」. byOwnAttack = only a Knock Out caused by the damage of this Pokémon's attack (「如果因这只宝可梦的招式的伤害，对手的宝可梦【昏厥】的话」). Read on the board at the Knock Out.

retreatRule.description: Retreat of the holder (I.A-03): ignoreConditions = 「即使处于【睡眠】或者【麻痹】状态，也可以撤退」 (step 1b does not apply; every other retreat condition still does); energyToHand = 「其【撤退】所需能量不会被放于弃牌区，而是会被放回手牌」 (step 2's Energy goes to its owner's hand).

toolCapacity.description: 「这只宝可梦身上可以最多放N张「宝可梦道具」」 (I.B-02 one Tool; II.A the card's own text first): the holder may have up to count Tools. When it stops applying, the Pokémon's owner puts Tools into the discard pile until it is within its capacity again, at the next rule check (printed 「当这个特性失效时，…放于弃牌区，直到还剩1张为止」).

recipientEffect.description: 「然后，回复那只宝可梦「N」点HP」 heal, 「然后，在被附着的宝可梦身上放置N个伤害指示物」 counters: done to each recipient right after a card is attached to it.

koSurvive.description: 「（当这只宝可梦的HP为全满的状态下，）这只宝可梦受到招式的伤害而【昏厥】时，（自己抛掷1次硬币。如果为正面，则）这只宝可梦不会【昏厥】，而是以剩余HP为「10」的状态留在场上」 (damage.survive): attack damage that would Knock it Out leaves it at 10 HP instead. fullHp = only if it had no damage counters before that damage (II.D-14); coin = its player flips 1 coin then, heads only. scope self (an Ability) or all (a timed effect pinned to its Pokémon).

attackTwice.description: 「（如果场上有「祭典会场」的话，则）这只宝可梦，可以连续使用2次拥有的招式」 (attack.twice): after one of its own printed attacks (and any Knock Outs and the new Active Pokémon), this Active Pokémon may declare one of its own printed attacks once more this turn.

conditionRule.description: Continuous Special Condition rules for matching Pokémon (status.rules): addCounters = 「因【中毒】／【灼伤】而放置的伤害指示物数量增加N个」 (all applicable increases add up, after any 「变为N个」 replacement); coins = 「因【睡眠】而抛掷的硬币次数变为2次，只有均为正面才会恢复」; noRecovery = 「【灼伤】状态，在宝可梦检查时抛掷的硬币即使为正面，也不会恢复」 (the coin is still flipped); keepOnEvolution = 「…所处于的特殊状态（【中毒】状态）不会因为进化、退化而恢复」 (the listed conditions remain).

affectedSelector.description: Only affected Pokémon matching this Pokémon selector (current types), e.g. 「自己的「连击」宝可梦」「名称中带有「X」的宝可梦」.

affectedState.description: Only affected Pokémon in this in-play state (damaged, carrying a Tool, with an Ability in effect, any listed Special Condition).

otherSelector.description: The other Pokémon of an attack's damage or effect must match: the Pokémon taking the damage for an attackDamage modifier; the attacking Pokémon for a defenseDamage modifier or a protection against attacks (「受到「宝可梦ex」的招式的伤害-30」).

otherTypeIsWeakness.description: attackDamage only: 「如果身上放有这张卡牌的宝可梦的弱点的属性，和对手的战斗宝可梦的属性相同的话」 — only while the Pokémon taking the damage has a current type that is the affected Pokémon's current Weakness type (属性相同 as in the Weakness step, I.A-01 step 3); never with no Weakness.

remainingHpAtMost.description: 「剩余HP在「N」（点）以下（包含N）」 of the affected Pokémon (target…) or of the attack's other Pokémon (other…), read whenever the effect is checked, from its current maximum HP and damage counters (II.D-16). Never on an HP modifier, which that maximum depends on.

boostedAttacks.description: An attackDamage modifier applies only to these attacks (「这只宝可梦的「X」造成的伤害+N」).

continuousCondition.description: The continuous effect applies only while this holds (II.A), judged from its source: self = the source Pokémon or the holder of the Tool/Energy. Board, zone and history queries only; no HP or Energy stat reads, damage target, coin, counted-effect or Prizes-taken facts. An absent holder makes a trait test false and a sum 0.

oneOf.description: 「不会陷入特殊状态，已经处于的特殊状态（也）全部恢复」 (I.F): an affected Pokémon cannot be affected by a Special Condition, and any it has is recovered at once.

conditions.description: 「不会陷入【睡眠】、【麻痹】状态」: only these Special Conditions (all five when absent).

preventOnly.description: 「不会陷入…状态」 printed without 「已经处于的…也全部恢复」: the condition cannot be applied, and nothing already present is recovered.

stages.description: Printed stage of each affected Pokémon, e.g. 「身上放有这张卡牌的【基础】宝可梦」「所有【2阶进化】宝可梦」.

perEnergyType.description: hp only: amount × the Energy units attached to the affected Pokémon that can provide this type now (「这只宝可梦身上每附有1个【钢】能量，这只宝可梦的最大HP就会增加「20」点」).

targetRetreatCost.description: 「身上放有这张卡牌的【撤退】所需能量为4个的宝可梦」: only while the affected Pokémon's current Retreat Cost is exactly this many Energy (never on a retreat modifier).

channel.description: damage: attack damage; effects: every effect of the listed sources; counters: 「不会因为…的效果而被放置伤害指示物」 — only damage counters those effects would place or move onto it.

useRule.description: Explicit independently reviewed use-eligibility classification, not a runtime permission toggle or an inference from matching origins. CN.E29 identifies the pinned hand Item/Supporter rule that permits use despite prevention; actual effects and then still use actual performed. No silent default. This implementation admits CN.E29 only as an in-play continuous Pokemon protection, not a timed ledger grant or Stadium-card target.

benchOnly.description: Only while the protected Pokémon is on the Bench (太晶: 「只要这只宝可梦，处于备战区，就不会受到招式的伤害」).

ruleBox.description: Only Pokémon without a Rule Box: 「（除「拥有规则的宝可梦」外）」.

coin.description: 「当这只宝可梦受到招式的伤害时，自己抛掷1次硬币。如果为正面，则这只宝可梦不受到该伤害」: each time the damage calculation reaches 6.最终伤害 for this Pokémon, its player flips 1 coin; only heads prevents that damage (I.A-01 步骤6, II.C-16).

damageAtMost.description: 「不会受到「60」点以下（包含60点）的招式的伤害」: only damage of at most this much, as calculated up to I.A-01 步骤6 (after Weakness, Resistance and other effects), is prevented.

specialRules.description: 「不受对手宝可梦所使用的GX招式的伤害和效果影响」: only attacks used as GX attacks (a copied GX attack too).

field.description: weaknessMultiplier = 「…的弱点，均以「×4」计算伤害」: a ×2 Weakness keeps its type and is applied as ×value. attackBaseDamage = 「这只宝可梦的「X」的伤害变为「100」」: value {attackIds, damage} replaces the listed attacks' damage before Weakness, Resistance and other effects.

specialRules.description: 「无法使用GX招式」: only attacks of these special rules are stopped (actions contains attack).

actions.description: heal: 「无法回复HP」 — every HP-healing effect leaves the affected Pokémon's damage counters unchanged; attachFromHand: 「无法从手牌将能量附着于…」 (the turn's attachment and effects attaching from hand); evolveFromHand: 「无法从手牌使出宝可梦放于…身上进行进化」.
